title: Map draft
status: Draft placements on the legacy continent map. Every placement is a lean for bt 7274 to move; the wiki owns the facts and the exact map stays open.

continents.name: The Northern Continent
continents.note: By shape: the clover-like land jutting into icy seas (legacy notes). Home to Northwind.

continents.name: The Western Continent
continents.note: By shape: the rounded land (legacy notes). Home to Ironcrest; Deepwood's main forest in its corner by the Spine (lean). The name is an old name, not a compass direction on this image (bt 7274, 2026-11-09).

continents.name: The Eastern Continent
continents.note: By shape: the tapering land (legacy notes). Highridge by the mountains, Greenvale in the middle, the Sunplains along the south and the tip, and Deepwood's western woods (lean).

spine.note: The Spine is drawn as mountains where the three continents meet; the plateau is placed astride it (lean).

regions.name: Northwind
regions.note: Much of the Northern Continent (Northwind page).

regions.name: Ironcrest
regions.note: The Western Continent, 'western upland country'. It reaches the Spine's foot, where it meets Greenvale at Stonefield Forge.

regions.name: Deepwood
regions.note: Lean: the main forest in the Western Continent's corner by the Spine (borders Ironcrest at Darkroot Gulch and Highridge at Twilighthollow), and a western enclave on the Eastern Continent (borders Greenvale). The legacy notes call Deepwood 'ancient forested enclaves'.

regions.name: Highridge Plateau
regions.note: Lean: the plateau astride the Spine, where the three continents meet by land, and the Eastern Continent's edge beside it ('elevated, mountain-adjacent'). It meets Northwind at Icestep Summit.

regions.name: Greenvale
regions.note: The Eastern Continent's middle ('north/central' in the legacy notes).

regions.name: Sunplains
regions.note: The southern extension: the south coast and the tapering tip.

waters.name: The Inner Sea
waters.note: Between the Northern Continent, the Spine and the Eastern Continent.

waters.name: The Narrows
waters.note: The strait between the Northern and Eastern Continents; Port stands on it.

waters.name: The North Gut
waters.note: The water between the Northern and Western Continents, north of the Spine.

waters.name: Footwater
waters.note: The lake at the Spine's foot, between the Western and Eastern Continents.

waters.name: The Long Channel
waters.note: The channel between the Western Continent and the Eastern Continent's tip.

waters.name: The White Current
waters.note: Runs south along the Northwind coast.

waters.name: The Salted Coast
waters.note: Named by the old disputes; each side means a slightly different stretch.

lines.name: The Long Water
lines.note: Rises at the Spine's foot, crosses Highridge's edge and Greenvale, and reaches the sea at Port (lean).

lines.name: The Reed
lines.note: A slow tributary; Reedveil Bend is on a bend of it.

lines.name: The Millburn
lines.note: A mill stream; the Drowned Bell is under its millpond.

lines.name: The Ember
lines.note: Ironcrest's working river, past Coalglen to the coast by the Spine.

lines.name: Cinder Brook
lines.note: A tributary of the Ember.

lines.name: The Brownwater
lines.note: A slow, tannin-dark river.

lines.name: The Braids
lines.note: A braided river of shifting channels.

lines.name: The Sallow
lines.note: The delta river.

lines.name: The Kings' Road
lines.note: Follows the Long Water down through the Kings' Gate to Port.

lines.name: The Carriers' Road
lines.note: From Barley Cross up to the Highridge corridors.

lines.name: The Drove Road
lines.note: For driving Highridge stock down to Greenvale's markets.

lines.name: The Milestone Way
lines.note: The old main corridor along the plateau, from Icestep down the Spine.

lines.name: The Salt Road
lines.note: From the Whitepan to the valley markets.

lines.name: The Herring Way
lines.note: From the coast across the Barrens to Icestep Summit.

lines.name: The Long Way
lines.note: The Northwind coast road to Frostbay Way.

lines.name: Ferry across the Narrows
lines.note: The Long Way's last stretch to Port is by boat (lean).

lines.name: The Ore Road
lines.note: From the Ironbacks through Emberhaven Cross to Highridge, across the Spine's flank.

lines.name: Road to Stonefield
lines.note: From Emberhaven Cross down to Stonefield Forge.

lines.name: The Charcoal Track
lines.note: Darkroot Gulch through the Charcoal Woods to the Ember forges.

lines.name: Gallows Cut
lines.note: A shortcut over the Ironbacks: half a day saved, a sprained ankle risked.

lines.name: The Hollow Way
lines.note: A sunken lane: a road in summer, a stream in winter.

lines.name: The Straight Road
lines.note: Forty miles dead straight, ending in a meadow.

lines.name: The Patrons' Road
lines.note: Between the coastal cities; every mile paved by a different patron.

lines.name: The Pilgrims' Way
lines.note: From the Hollin Gap up to the Cradle.

lines.name: The Overpath
lines.note: Over the top of the Spine, for those who won't go under.

lines.name: The Underpass
lines.note: Beneath parts of the Spine; branches not mapped.

unplaced.name: The Treaty Stones and the Treaty Line
unplaced.why: The Treaty Line (the Convergence boundary) isn't placed; the borders stay open.

unplaced.name: The Roamers' Round
unplaced.why: A circuit, not a place: through Kellerby and along the Straight Road in summer, back to the Fiddlers' Hollow for winter.

unplaced.name: Seven Hill's pass
unplaced.why: Which pass Seven Hill guards is open on its own page.

unplaced.name: Port's districts (the Throat, Lamp Point, the Inner Pool, the Old Bond, the Enclave Quarter, the Lean, Three Pots Street)
unplaced.why: Too small for this map's scale; the places of interest in them are placed at Port.
